description: Insulation contractor in Fremont, CA serving homes from Mission San Jose to Warm Springs, 18 miles south of our San Leandro base. Get a free inspection.
intro: East Bay Insulation serves Fremont from our San Leandro base, about 18 miles south. The city stretches from Mission San Jose down to Warm Springs, and we take insulation jobs anywhere in between.

sections.h2: One crew across a large city
paragraphs: Fremont covers a lot of ground, and its housing stock varies from block to block. That mix is exactly why we inspect first and quote second, on every job in the city.
The distance from our base does not change the service. One crew handles the job end to end, from the first visit through the follow-up.

bullets: Crawl space encapsulation and vapor barriers

faqs.q: How far is Fremont from your base?
faqs.a: About 18 miles south of San Leandro. We schedule Fremont inspections the same way we schedule local ones, usually within the week.

faqs.q: Do you cover all of Fremont?
faqs.a: Yes, from Mission San Jose to Warm Springs and the neighborhoods in between.

faqs.q: What should Fremont homeowners inspect first?
faqs.a: Attics and crawl spaces usually, and the inspection tells us where your house is losing the most heat. The estimate is free and written.
